title: Underlying sheaf forgetful functor preserves module-sheaf colimits
statement: For a scheme X, a commutative ring Λ, and a small diagram D of Λ-module sheaves on the small etale site of X, the sheafCompose functor induced by ModuleCat Λ → AddCommGrpCat preserves colimits of D.

proof.text: Form presheaf colimits sectionwise, use preservation of colimits by the module forgetful functor, and compare module and abelian sheafification after forgetting scalars.
